preferences.heading: Notification preferences
preferences.intro: There are two channels and only two: in-app and email. Choose what reaches you on each.
preferences.error: That preference could not be saved. Try again.
preferences.alwaysOn: Some notifications in this group reach you whatever the setting: <bdi>{list}</bdi>

new_sessions.name: New sessions
new_sessions.hint: A session was published, or a booking window opened for you early.

my_sessions.name: My sessions
my_sessions.hint: Anything about a seat you hold: confirmation, waitlist, check-in, materials added afterwards.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.hint: A week before, a day before, two hours before.

ratings.name: Ratings
ratings.hint: An invitation to rate a session you attended, an hour after it ends.

social.name: Comments and mentions
social.hint: A reply to your comment, or a mention of you in one.

recognition.name: Points and recognition
recognition.hint: A badge, a level, a completed streak, a month's board closing.

certificates.name: Certificates
certificates.hint: A certificate issued to you or revoked.
certificates.why: A certificate in your name that you do not know about is a certificate lost, so it always reaches you.

moderation.name: Moderation
moderation.hint: Content of yours hidden or removed.
moderation.why: What is removed without your knowing cannot be appealed, so it always reaches you.

proposals.name: Proposals
proposals.hint: A decision on your proposal, or an invitation to co-present.

admin_queue.name: Admin queue
admin_queue.hint: A proposal waiting on your review, or a report that arrived.

account.name: Account
account.hint: Your role changing, your account being deactivated, your calendar disconnected, your data ready.
account.why: A change to your account you do not know about is a change you cannot question, so it always reaches you.

emails.title: Email
emails.intro: The templates of the messages members receive by email, and a log of what was sent and why a send failed. Your organisation's template wins over the default.
emails.failures: {count, plural, =0 {No message failed in the last seven days.} one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> message failed in the last seven days.} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> messages failed in the last seven days.}}

catalogue.empty: No email messages in the notification matrix.

editor.heading: Template “<bdi>{name}</bdi>”
editor.usingDefault: This message arrives with the default template, whose text is not shown here yet: an organisation template is written from scratch.
editor.overridden: This message arrives with your organisation's template.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.bodyHint: Write it in Arabic. Dynamic fields are written by name between double braces.
editor.requiredFieldsHint: The names of fields the subject or body must contain, separated by commas. A text without one is refused.
editor.restoreBody: Your organisation's template for this message is deleted, and it arrives with the default text from now on. Your template cannot be recovered afterward.
editor.restored: The message is back on the default template

errors.bodyTooLong: The body is longer than allowed.
errors.requiredFieldsInvalid: Enter field names in Latin letters, separated by commas.
errors.missingRequiredField: Neither the subject nor the body contains the field <bdi>{field}</bdi>.
errors.unknownMessageKey: This message is not in the notification matrix, or is not sent by email.
errors.notPermitted: This page is for organisation admins.
errors.failed: The template could not be saved. Try again.

deliveries.heading: Delivery log
deliveries.intro: Every send attempt is recorded with its outcome, and the reason when it failed.
deliveries.bounceNote: A bounce after the message was accepted is not recorded yet: this shows what the email provider refused at the moment of sending.
deliveries.retention: {count, plural, one {The log is kept for <bdi>{value}</bdi> day.} other {The log is kept for <bdi>{value}</bdi> days.}}

reasons.rateLimited: The organisation went over the email provider's sending limit.
reasons.providerRefused: The email provider refused the message.
reasons.providerUnavailable: The email provider did not respond.
reasons.unreachable: The email provider could not be reached.

deliveries.emptyFailedTitle: No failures — every message went out

reminders.title: Reminder schedule
reminders.intro: Reminders arrive this long before a session. Changing the schedule moves pending reminders rather than duplicating them.

before.minutes: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> minute} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> minutes}} before
before.hours: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> hour} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> hours}} before
before.days: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> day} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> days}} before

reminders.promptImmediate: Rating prompt: as soon as the session ends

promptAfter.minutes: Rating prompt: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> minute} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> minutes}} after the session ends
promptAfter.hours: Rating prompt: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> hour} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> hours}} after the session ends
promptAfter.days: Rating prompt: {count, plural, one {<bdi>{value}</bdi> day} other {<bdi>{value}</bdi> days}} after the session ends

reminders.offsetsHint: From five minutes to thirty days, and six reminders at most.
reminders.genericNote: A reminder near a week, a day or two hours before arrives with its own dedicated message. Any other offset you choose arrives with a general message that states the exact date and time instead of assuming a full week or day.
reminders.promptLabel: Rating prompt after the session ends
reminders.promptHint: Zero means as soon as the session ends; a week at most.
reminders.saved: Schedule saved and pending reminders moved

errors.offsetInvalid: Enter a whole number above zero.
errors.offsetTooShort: A reminder is at least five minutes before.
errors.offsetTooLong: A reminder is at most thirty days before.
errors.offsetDuplicate: Another reminder already has this time.
errors.promptInvalid: Enter a whole number, or zero to send it as the session ends.
errors.promptTooLong: The rating prompt is at most a week after.
errors.failed: The schedule could not be saved. Try again.
